name: Formation Approval Route Step
description: One configured step of a formation approval route. Steps are configuration: a step can be added, reordered or made parallel without a deployment.

fields.label: Sequence
fields.description: Steps sharing a sequence in Parallel mode are raised together.

fields.label: Required Role
fields.description: The access role a decider must hold. Both this and the record's own accountability must hold.

fields.label: Assign To Field
fields.description: A fieldname on the request naming the person this step is assigned to, e.g. delegating_authority. Read as configuration.

fields.label: Assign To User
fields.description: A fixed assignee, where the step is not derived from the request.
